---
title: "Stage 3 — author the derivation"
---

Turning collected measurements into the analysis value the endpoint is about.

## What this is

A Derivation Concept is a step that computes: select a baseline, subtract it, impute, window
a visit. Chains of them turn what was collected into what is analysed.

## What you do

Pick the transformation, bind its roles to concepts, and set its configuration.

## What you should see

A chain whose output is the analysis value — here, change from baseline.

## What to look out for

**Dependencies resolve by output concept and exact string equality.** A step that emits a
`Flag` can never satisfy a step that wants a `Measure`, however obviously related they are to
a human reader. This is the mechanism behind one of the sharper findings in the factory: the
baseline *flag* and the baseline *value* are disconnected, and no amount of naming fixes it.

When a step refuses to accept an input that looks right, check the output concept before you
check anything else.
